blocks.markdown: The Mac CI correction is merged in [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183); all four required checks now pass on the resulting main version. The unsent-draft recovery repair is independently reviewed, passes local checks and is published in [PR 184](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184), awaiting required automated checks. A small inactive-Project skill-control issue is being corrected separately.
Last refreshed: **20 October 2026 at 15:46 Europe/Tallinn**. This is a saved progress summary, not live activity.

- **Unsent draft recovery repair:** [PR 184](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184) preserves typed drafts when the first passage comment creates a writing conversation. Both review findings are fixed: background work cannot hide the recovery warning, and dismissing it preserves a separate unseen error. Final desktop checks passed 340 tests with one existing ignored; storage safeguards, lint, production build and independent review also passed. Required hosted checks and actual Mac close/reopen remain pending.

- **More reliable export completion:** [PR181](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/181) is merged and all four required checks now pass on its resulting main version. The original Mac45-minute cancellation is preserved alongside the successful exact-source retry. Actual Mac export and broader durability observation remain separate.

1. The CI correction’s required main checks passed. Verify exact-version checks for the separate [draft repair](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184) before normal integration. Separately fix misleading skill Enable choices in inactive Projects; the underlying service already refuses these writes safely.

**No decision is needed from you now.** PR 183 is merged with all four required main checks passing; PR 184 is reviewed and locally checked, with hosted checks running. Optional Windows failures remain recorded. Actual Mac interaction remains separate; no owner data or live account call was used for the draft repair.
